prompt_en: Create a vertical 9:16 anime-style music illustration of a young woman in a neon cyberpunk night scene. The subject is a stylish anime girl with long dark purple-black hair with pink and blue rim highlights, shown from the waist up in a dynamic three-quarter pose, her hair blown dramatically across the frame. She wears large glossy over-ear DJ headphones with glowing cyan and magenta rings, a black choker, a delicate necklace, a loose white camisole, and an oversized dark jacket slipping off one shoulder. Her right hand lightly touches the headphones near her ear. Place a perfectly centered opaque square censor block over the face, covering the eyes, nose, and mouth, colored muted mauve-purple. Surround her with an energetic audio-visual swirl: exactly 8 prominent glowing musical notes, including 3 hot-pink notes near the upper left and upper right, 2 cyan notes on the left side, 1 cyan-and-pink note on the right edge, and 2 pink notes near the lower foreground. Add luminous curved light trails wrapping around her body, sparkling particles, star-like bokeh, and digital equalizer bars along the lower edge. Use electric blue, violet, magenta, hot pink, and deep black, high-contrast glossy lighting, detailed anime rendering, dramatic rim light, vibrant concert atmosphere, sharp hair strands, reflective headphone surfaces, and a dense magical music aura. Center the composition around one huge raised clay fist emerging from behind a dark charcoal rounded rectangle strip across the bottom third. Behind the fist place one large red folded ribbon/banner shape spreading left and right, and one blue spiky burst shape directly behind the fist. At the top, add one oversized bold white 3D clay headline reading 懦夫救世!, with rounded puffy edges, slight red shadowing, and one red clay star used as the dot/accent near the final exclamation area. Add exactly one circular profile avatar at the lower left overlapping the dark bottom strip: a cute beige clay character with large googly eyes holding a small microphone, framed by a dark ring. Add exactly one rounded black button at the lower right with a thin light outline and small white Chinese text reading 编辑个人资料. Use soft polymer-clay texture everywhere, visible fingerprints, rounded handmade edges, macaroon warm colors, shallow depth of field, and realistic stop-motion lighting. No photorealistic skin, no flat vector look, no extra characters, no watermark.\

title: 轨道站零重力踢
author: Cleveland Tobias
categories: 漫画 / 分镜,游戏素材,动漫 / 漫画,赛博朋克 / 科幻,角色,风景 / 自然
prompt_en: Create a cinematic widescreen sci-fi anime action illustration inside a damaged orbital space station corridor, with Earth and deep space visible through a huge panoramic window. The scene shows exactly two armored figures in zero gravity: on the right, teal green powered astronaut armor with glowing blue-white jet thrusters on the back, shoulders, and boots, flying horizontally from right to left and delivering a full-force side kick; on the left, beige and dark gray humanoid combat android or armored astronaut recoils from the kick, chest shattered with fragments and sparks bursting outward. The attacker’s leg is fully extended into the defender’s torso, one arm punched forward and the other pulled back, body tilted dynamically as if propelled by suit jets. Count the major visible subjects and effects precisely: 2 armored figures, 1 enormous curved observation window, 1 view of Earth’s blue horizon with swirling clouds, 1 small satellite outside the window, 2 side balcony platforms, 1 control console at lower right, many floating metal shards and glass fragments, and multiple orange sparks and blue energy streaks arcing through the room. Use a polished Japanese anime / graphic novel style with crisp ink outlines, dramatic perspective, high contrast cel shading, detailed mechanical panels, pipes, rails, and sci-fi wall seams. Lighting should be cold cyan from Earth and the window, accented by orange impact sparks and vivid blue thruster glows. Make the composition dynamic and diagonal, with debris trails and motion arcs emphasizing weightless movement. Canvas: 16:9 widescreen. Mood: intense orbital combat. No text, no logos, no watermark.\

prompt_en: A realistic outdoor portrait of a thoughtful, naturally beautiful young woman standing on a garden path in soft golden-hour light. She is framed from about mid-thigh upward, centered in the image, facing the camera with a relaxed upright posture. She has dark brown long, voluminous, loosely curly hair with a slightly tousled texture, falling around her shoulders. Dress her in an oversized cream-white knit sweater with long sleeves and dark high-waisted loose trousers or a flowing skirt-like bottom in deep navy or black. A pair of thin round eyeglasses hangs from the neckline of the sweater. In one hand she holds a sharpened yellow pencil, and in the other she carries an open sketchbook or notebook with slightly worn pages, suggesting she is writing, sketching, or observing nature. The mood should feel literary, artistic, intelligent, and understated rather than glamorous. Place her in a lush garden with 1 visible stone pathway, abundant soft greenery, and blurred flowers in the foreground and background. Use shallow depth of field with creamy bokeh, warm sunlight filtering through trees behind her, and gentle natural highlights on her hair and sweater. The image should look like a candid editorial photograph, highly realistic, soft and tasteful, with muted natural colors, subtle texture, and an atmosphere of calm, cultured beauty. Vertical composition, 4:5 portrait orientation.\

The detective wears a wide-brim fedora, high-collared wet trench coat, dress shirt, and dark tie; his body is cropped from chest upward and turned slightly toward camera, occupying the right half of the frame. The setting is a narrow brick alley in a rainy old city; wet cobblestones reflect the streetlamp, white mist rises near the ground, rain falls in vertical streaks, and brick walls with rough mortar texture frame the scene. Lighting should be dramatic: the streetlamp creates a glowing halo on the left while the detective remains mostly in shadow, with rim light catching raindrops on the coat and hat. Use a cinematic wide landscape composition, monochrome only, no color, no captions, no speech bubbles, no watermark.\

author: Resource Daily
categories: 应用 / 网页设计,信息图 / 教育视觉,动漫 / 漫画,极简主义,文字 / 排版,抽象 / 背景
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a clean GitHub README-style landing page screenshot promoting GPT Image 2 Prompt Gallery + Agentic Skill + CLI, with a centered title area and a large fantasy-anime hero banner underneath.

Canvas: 890×650 px webpage screenshot on a white background, with generous margins and a thin light-gray horizontal divider below the title. Use a crisp browser/documentation aesthetic, no browser chrome.

Layout: Top-left has a small black chain-link anchor icon. Centered at the top is the large bold headline “GPT Image 2 Prompt Gallery + Agentic Skill + CLI”. Under it, place an italic two-line subtitle: “OpenAI GPT Image 2 prompt gallery, image prompt library, agentic skill, and CLI — curated, copy-paste prompts and runnable examples for skill-capable agents.” Below that, centered language links read “English · 中文” in blue underlined link style. Under the language links, place exactly 6 small rectangular status badges in one row: “License MIT”, “PRs welcome”, “model gpt-image-2”, and “python ≥3.11”, with the first two labels split into dark-gray label + green value, the model badge split dark-gray label + purple value, and the python badge split dark-gray label + blue value. Below, place exactly 3 centered ranking badges in one row: “oosmetrics Top 1 Agents”, “oosmetrics Top 1 LLMs”, and “oosmetrics Top 1 CLI”, using dark-gray label segments and muted blue/purple value segments.

Hero banner: Place one large wide rectangular illustration beneath the badges, spanning almost the full content width with small white margins. The banner is a richly detailed fantasy workshop scene in warm cinematic lighting, anime/chibi style, with a black brush-stroke sign across the upper center reading GPTImage2Skill in large rough gold lettering. The background shows a magical cave workshop with glowing UI panels, floating icons, scrolls, prompt sheets, potion-like colorful orbs, tools, and a mountain landscape opening in the distance.

Characters and objects in the hero banner: Include exactly 8 chibi fantasy characters arranged across the banner, each holding or presenting image-generation artifacts: 1 boy on the left holding a parchment and raising a fist, 1 purple-clothed character at bottom-left holding a dramatic anime image, 1 green-clothed character near lower-left holding a diagram/spec sheet, 1 elderly robed character near center-left, 1 small red-clothed character in the center, 1 green/yellow character near center-right holding a phone-style UI sheet, 1 smiling orange/green character near lower-right holding a realistic bird photo, and 1 blue/green character at far right holding a poster and a dashboard panel. Add several additional partial humanoid figures behind them if needed, but the 8 foreground chibi characters must remain visually dominant. Render the humanoid faces as intentionally blurred or masked soft tan rectangles, as if anonymized, while keeping costumes, poses, hands, and held images sharp.

Visual style: Combine clean documentation page typography with a vibrant high-detail fantasy anime illustration. The page area should be flat and white; the hero image should be saturated, warm, magical, and highly detailed with glowing cyan and gold accents. Keep all visible text legible where specified, avoid adding extra paragraphs, watermarks, logos, or browser controls.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a highly realistic physical museum-diorama style city map titled TOKYO — NOCTURNAL URBAN ARCHIVE, showing Tokyo at night as a layered architectural archive model on a dark tabletop.

Canvas: Wide landscape image, 3:2 aspect ratio, viewed from an elevated oblique angle. The entire scene is a rectangular black archival board with a thin cream double-line border, coordinate grid, index markings, and printed cartographic annotations. Use a restrained night palette: charcoal paper, navy water, warm amber city lights, cool white road lines, and selective blue/purple tower lighting.

Layout: The main map occupies the upper 80% of the board and shows an ultra-dense 3D miniature urban model with thousands of low-rise buildings, raised clusters of skyscrapers, glowing roads, rail lines, bridges, waterways, parks, and harbor piers. The bottom 20% is a printed archive information strip containing a legend on the left, the title block in the center, a scale bar, a north arrow, and an index grid on the right. Add realistic paper grain, matte model surfaces, tiny cast shadows, engraved-looking map lines, and soft studio lighting from above.

City content: Depict Tokyo as a nocturnal urban archive. Include exactly 9 labeled landmark callout plaques on the map, each black with thin cream borders and bilingual Japanese/English styling: 1) Shinjuku, 2) Shibuya, 3) Imperial Palace, 4) Ueno, 5) Asakusa, 6) Tokyo Skytree, 7) Ginza, 8) Odaiba, 9) Tokyo Bay. Place Shinjuku as a dense blue-lit skyscraper cluster on the left, Shibuya lower-left, the dark green Imperial Palace park in the center, Tokyo Tower glowing orange near the center-lower area, Tokyo Skytree glowing blue-purple on the right, Ginza near the waterfront, Odaiba on an island near the bottom, and Tokyo Bay as dark navy water on the right.

Map details: Add a coordinate frame with columns numbered 1 through 10 across the top and rows labeled A through E down the left edge. Include latitude/longitude markings around the border. Show a dense street network as fine pale lines, major expressways as brighter sweeping curves, rail lines as subtly colored routes, and water areas as smooth dark navy shapes. Include a prominent illuminated suspension bridge across Tokyo Bay in the lower-right quadrant.

Bottom archive strip: Include exactly 1 legend box on the bottom-left with the heading “Legend” and 8 line/style entries: 1) Yamanote Line, 2) JR / Chuo Line, 3) Ginza Line, 4) Asakusa Line, 5) Yurikamome Line, 6) Water, 7) Major Road, 8) Park / Green. In the center title block, print “TOKYO — NOCTURNAL URBAN ARCHIVE”, a smaller subtitle “Landscape Archive Model”, and an archive code TKY-NAM-2024-001. Include exactly 1 scale bar labeled “Scale 1:25,000” with tick labels from 0 to 2.5 km. Include exactly 1 north arrow and exactly 1 index grid at the far right with 25 cells labeled A1 through E5.

Visual style: Photorealistic macro photography of a handcrafted physical cartographic diorama, like an architectural museum model photographed in a dark studio. Use crisp micro-detail, shallow-but-readable depth of field, realistic shadows under elevated buildings, reflective water, warm window glows, and subtle paper texture. No people, no cars large enough to dominate, no extra landmarks beyond the specified labels, no watermark.\

Canvas: Tall vertical 9:16 poster, high-resolution, with a black and hot-pink neon border rounded at the corners. Use a dense graffiti alley background with brick walls, spray paint, torn-paper textures, white scribble outlines, pink light streaks, and sticker-like graphic elements.

Subject details: The same young woman appears in all five images, with light-to-medium skin, long dark brown hair in two braids, hoop earrings, a white knit beanie with a black graffiti tag logo, silver over-ear headphones, and edgy streetwear. Outfit: black cropped tank top with a distressed pink graffiti graphic, loose dark gray cargo pants, black grommet belt with a metal buckle, silver chain accessories, and black-and-white sneakers. Overall mood is confident, youthful, urban, and pop-punk.

Layout: Use exactly 5 discrete appearances of the woman:
1. Large close-up portrait on the upper left, cropped at the chest, wearing the white beanie and silver headphones around her neck.
2. Full-body standing pose on the upper right, leaning casually with hands in pockets, headphones around her neck, cargo pants fully visible.
3. Central mid-shot cutout, holding white sunglasses near her face, outlined with an irregular white torn-paper border.
4. Lower-left seated or crouched pose, one hand touching the beanie, headphones around her neck.
5. Lower-right waist-up pose, both hands lifting or adjusting the headphones near her ears.

Graphic text content: Include exactly 4 main neon typography phrases in hand-lettered graffiti style: “NEON VIBE” large on the left in pink, white, and purple; “STREET POP” near the upper center-right in glowing pink; “URBAN MOOD” on the right-middle in glowing pink; and “GIRL POWER” near the bottom center in pink and white with paint splatter and a small crown doodle.

Visual style: Bright cyberpunk pink neon lighting, glossy magazine collage, high-contrast black shadows, magenta highlights, white sketch arrows, star doodles, smiley doodles, hearts, paint splatters, torn photo edges, and layered sticker aesthetics. The final image should feel like a Y2K streetwear poster, energetic and polished, with all five cutouts clearly separated but visually connected by neon scribbles.

Constraints: Keep the same identity and outfit consistent across all five appearances. Do not add extra people. Do not add additional large text beyond the four listed phrases.
